projects.title: Streamify
projects.desc: A full-stack YouTube + Twitter hybrid where users can stream videos, post tweets, like, comment & subscribe. Features secure JWT auth and a dedicated admin panel.
projects.longDesc:
Streamify is a scalable, full-stack social video streaming platform inspired by YouTube and Twitter. The idea was to build not just a video player, but a complete social ecosystem where users can watch videos and interact socially via tweets.

The platform covers end-to-end functionality - from secure user authentication to high-performance video delivery.

Key Features:
- User Authentication & Profile: JWT-based login/signup, avatar/cover upload.
- Video Ecosystem: Video upload & streaming with Cloudinary & Multer, history, likes, comments.
- Social Layer: Twitter-like tweet creation and real-time like system.
- Subscription System: Full YouTube-like channel subscription model.
- Admin Panel: Dashboard for creators to upload, edit, delete and manage videos.

projects.title: Realtime Pizza Tracking App
projects.desc: A full-stack pizza ordering platform with real-time order status tracking using WebSockets, cart system and admin panel.
projects.longDesc: A full-stack pizza delivery application with real-time order tracking. Users can order pizzas, manage cart, and track order status live from placed to delivered using Socket.io. Includes a powerful admin panel to manage orders and products.

projects.title: Portfolio Website
projects.desc: Modern, responsive personal portfolio with glassmorphism UI, MDX blog support and SEO optimization.
projects.longDesc: A modern and performant portfolio website built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS. Features glassmorphism UI, fully responsive design, MDX-powered blog, and optimized for SEO and performance.

projects.title: To-Do App
projects.desc: A minimal and fast to-do app with add, edit, delete and complete functionality using Context API and Local Storage.
projects.longDesc: A clean and fast to-do application built with Vite and React. Uses React Context API for efficient state management and Local Storage for data persistence. Users can add, edit, delete and mark tasks as completed.

projects.title: Weather App
projects.desc: A dynamic weather app that shows real-time weather data for any city using OpenWeather API.
projects.longDesc: A responsive weather application built with Vite and JavaScript. Fetches real-time weather data from OpenWeather API with features like city search, temperature, humidity, wind speed and dynamic backgrounds based on weather.

projects.title: Password Generator
projects.desc: A secure random password generator with customizable length, numbers, and special characters.
projects.longDesc: A handy tool to generate strong and secure random passwords. Users can customize password length, include numbers and special characters, and copy to clipboard with one click. Built with React and Tailwind.

projects.title: Gradient Generator
projects.desc: A tool for developers and designers to create, preview and copy beautiful CSS gradients instantly.
projects.longDesc: A simple and useful gradient generator for developers. Create custom linear gradients, preview in real-time, and copy the CSS code instantly. Helps in speeding up UI development.

about.longBio:
I'm Ashish Singh, a Full-Stack Developer based in Jabalpur, India, with 3+ years of experience in designing and developing scalable, high-performance web applications using the MERN stack. I specialize in building intuitive frontends with React and Next.js, secure backends with Node.js, Express, and MongoDB.

My approach is rooted in complete ownership and product thinking. I am committed to writing clean, maintainable, and well-documented code, ensuring transparent communication, and delivering high-quality solutions on time. My focus is always on performance, scalability, and crafting seamless user experiences by transforming complex requirements into elegant and efficient solutions.
